title: RLHF: A comprehensive Survey for Cultural, Multimodal and Low Latency Alignment Methods
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any specific aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on cultural and demographic fairness more broadly, using benchmarks like NormAd-ETI and Open-Opinions.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
